coop v9.0.0-187-g1176bf4-dirty — run a coding agent all night long in a box it can't escape.

Usage: coop <command> [<args>...]

THE BOX — an isolated environment for running commands in this project
  coop run -- <command>             run a command in the box
  coop shell                        open a shell in the box

RUN AGENTS — work with a coding agent or a team of agents
  coop <agent>                      start Claude, Codex, Gemini, or Grok
  coop <preset>                     run agents together using a preset
  coop <target> --peer <target>...  start with read-only peer agents

  A target names an agent, a preset, or a model: codex:gpt-5.6-luna/xhigh

ACCOUNTS, MODELS & PRESETS — choose the accounts and models your agents use
  coop login <agent>                sign in to an agent
  coop credentials [<agent>]        show your signed in accounts
  coop models [<agent>]             show available models
  coop presets [<name>]             show your presets

TASKS — each task is a folder in .agent/tasks/
  coop tasks ls                     show tasks grouped by status
  coop tasks watch [--json]         follow task progress
  coop tasks add "<title>"          add a task
  coop tasks decisions              show tasks waiting for your decision
  coop backlog                      save ideas for later
  coop context [<path>...]          show which instructions and docs apply to selected files

LOOPS — work through tasks automatically; configure the steps in .agent/loop.yaml
  coop loop [<agent|preset>]        work through the project's task queue

FORKS — work in separate project copies, then review and merge the changes
  coop fork <name> <agent|preset>   work in a separate copy of this project
  coop fork ls                      show this project's forks
  coop fork review <name>           review a fork's changes
  coop fork merge <name>            merge a fork's changes into this branch
  coop fork merge --all             merge all forks into this branch
  coop fork logs [<name>]           show loop logs for one or all forks
  coop fork rm <name>               delete a fork
  coop fork stop <name>             stop a fork's background loop
  coop fork open <name>             open a fork in your editor
  coop fork path <name>             print a fork's directory path

SERVICES — postgres and redis, defined in .agent/compose.yml
  coop init --services              choose services to add
  coop up                           start services from .agent/compose.yml
  coop down                         stop services from .agent/compose.yml

SECURITY & ISOLATION — control access, check isolation, and protect secrets
  coop doctor                       check that the box's isolation works
  coop net                          show and manage this project's network access
  coop check-secrets                check project files for exposed secrets
  coop sign                         sign unpushed commits with your host key

SETUP & MAINTENANCE — set up projects and manage Coop on this machine
  coop init                         set up Coop in this project
  coop build                        rebuild the box
  coop update                       update Coop and the box
  coop version                      show the installed Coop version

INTEGRATIONS — use Coop with other tools and your shell
  coop help acp                     connect Coop to your editor
  coop help sessions                let other applications start and manage agents
  coop help prompt                  add Coop status to your shell prompt or tmux
  coop help completion              enable tab completion in Bash or Zsh

Help and examples: coop help <command>
Documentation: https://coop.dryga.com
